resolvedSourceFindings.issue: Saved explanation attributes 13x−6 to treating the blue count as 4x, but that model actually gives x+2x+4x+(4x−6)=11x−6.
resolvedSourceFindings.resolution: Rewritten chained-count distractor is 8x−5, matching x+3x+2x+(2x−5); every option is separately checked against the correct full polynomial.
